operationalization.definition: f1_ratio = reconstruction Test F1 / fused Test F1; localization_gap = classification AC@1 - reconstruction AC@1 (both measured with their own trigger anchors on the same score source).

decision.rationale: Reconstruction-only localization AC@1 stays close to classification AC@1.

label_identity_audit.definition: For every GT injection, the AD positive node set on each overlapped 30s bin is compared with the RCA labelled root service identity.  Both labels come from the same frozen registry service column, so the identity is structural; this audit quantifies it and measures bin-level multi-event ambiguity.
label_identity_audit.exact_identity_definition: every overlapped bin has AD positive set exactly equal to the event service
